src/agent_runtime/progress/init.py

Python · Tier A

User-only, deterministic observations. Never an execution authority.

src/agent_runtime/progress/main.py

Python · Tier A

Print developer progress coverage without exposing it to model tool schemas.

src/agent_runtime/progress/conformance.py

Python · Tier A

Offline extension checks; callers supply captured fixtures, never live services.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
check_provider 8 Check replay determinism, bounded state, pure reads and instance isolation. This is a developer test helper, not a sandbox for untrusted Python code. Extension tests must also forbid their model, network and process clients.

src/agent_runtime/progress/contracts.py

Python · Tier A

Define immutable, bounded progress evidence, parser state, public reports and per-skill provider declarations. Validators enforce measurement consistency, encoded-size limits and complete support classification; coverage reports implementation gaps without running extractors. Providers fold existing events synchronously, while publication, event collection and the private diagnostic latch belong to their callers.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
Frozen 24 Base for immutable progress records with closed fields and explicitly permitted provider objects. Frozen attributes alone do not recursively freeze arbitrary payloads; evidence uses the separate freeze projection.
Measurement 30 Describe one finite nonnegative work/activity counter with a source-owned identity, label, unit and scope. A total is optional and, when supplied, cannot be lower than completed work.
Measurement.valid_total 42 Reject a completed count above its declared exact total, preserving indeterminate progress when total is absent.
ProgressDetails 51 Bound a provider's human-facing availability, phase, explanation, measurements and output excerpt. At most eight measurements carry their provenance; no field establishes execution completion or authorization.
ProgressState 69 Retain bounded progress details and a JSON-encoded provider-private parser checkpoint. The private parser state supports incremental observation and is excluded from public reports by their separate schema.
ProgressState.bounded 77 Require valid parser JSON and cap the complete serialized UTF-8 provider state at 64 KiB; oversized or malformed state raises before persistence.
freeze 86 Recursively project dictionaries to read-only mappings and sequences to tuples so a progress provider cannot mutate decoded evidence through its public data view.
validate_return 94 Revalidate even unchecked model_copy/model_construct provider returns.
ProgressEvidence 116 Identify a retained observation by request, operation, tool, event cursor and timestamp, keeping its bounded-by-caller payload serialized until a provider reads it.
ProgressEvidence.data 128 Decode the retained JSON payload and recursively freeze its containers for read-only provider inspection; malformed JSON propagates as a validation error.
ProgressProvider 136 Define the synchronous incremental extraction interface: observe folds one retained event into private state, and get_progress returns its current bounded public details. Implementations must not own execution or provider I/O.
ProgressProvider.observe 139 Fold a typed retained event and optional prior parser state into a new ProgressState; providers implement this as a synchronous state computation.
ProgressProvider.get_progress 144 Project public ProgressDetails from a saved ProgressState without advancing execution or fetching new evidence.
SkillProgressDefinition 150 Declare versioned progress ownership for a skill: supported/unsupported tools, accepted evidence kinds, optional run-level provider and explicit delegation for reused operations. Registration validates this declaration against actual skill ownership.
SkillProgressDefinition.coherent 166 Require a callable synchronous provider with compatible signatures for supported/run-level progress, declared source evidence and reasons for unsupported tools. Reject derived snapshots as extraction input and conflicting wildcard declarations; this validates the interface, not arbitrary provider purity.
SkillProgressDefinition.unavailable 193 Construct an explicit all-tools-unsupported declaration with a reason and default delegation of reused tools; no dummy provider or progress estimate is created.
SkillProgressDefinition.validate_skill 201 Revalidate version and provider coherence, require every owned tool to appear exactly once across support sets, and require explicit delegation when the skill reuses another owner's tools.
SkillProgressDefinition.supports 215 Test whether the declaration includes a tool explicitly or through the supported wildcard; callers still validate the declaration against its owning skill.
ProgressReport 222 Attach request/run/task/activity/job identities, evidence cursor and observation timestamps to public progress details. The report intentionally omits provider-private parser state and has its own wire-size limit.
ProgressReport.bounded_report 245 Reject public progress whose complete JSON encoding exceeds 8 KiB, including identity fields and measurement metadata.
coverage 254 Build a per-skill progress-support inventory, naming delegated owners and invalid declarations without executing providers. complete means all declarations validate, not that every tool has a detailed extractor.
private_observation 288 For recognized progress events, validate typed fields and omit free-text detail/output before returning diagnostic metadata. The caller owns the private-content latch; this helper returns an empty mapping for invalid or unrelated events and does not decide whether to publish.

src/agent_runtime/progress/engine.py

Python · Tier A

Bounded observational worker over captured traces; no execution-state writers.

Details

The append tap only wakes this observer. Providers run outside trace/execution locks. Derived snapshots are never inputs, native events, or model-visible observations.
